BetterTube is a privacy-friendly YouTube client for Android, forked from [LibreTube](https://github.com/libre-tube/LibreTube). Its audio-only mode really saves data, and the whole app has been redesigned to feel calm, modern and fast.

## Install

Download **`BetterTube-v0.3.2.apk`** below and open it on your phone. Android may ask you to allow installs from your browser or file manager. BetterTube installs next to the official LibreTube app.

> [!NOTE]
> **Already on v0.2.x or v0.3.x?** This installs as an update and keeps your data.
>
> **Coming from a v0.1.x preview?** Those were a separate test app, so move over once: in the old BetterTube, Settings → Backup and restore → **Backup**; install this version; in the new BetterTube, **Restore** the backup; then uninstall the old one.

## What's new in 0.3.2

**Faster, steadier downloads.** Downloads come in larger pieces with fewer pauses between them, and ride out short drops in signal instead of stopping. Long-paused downloads pick up fresh links by themselves. Starting a download on mobile data no longer pauses the others; downloads only pause when you move from Wi-Fi to mobile data.

**Watch later, quicker.**
- Share a YouTube link to BetterTube and pick **Watch later**: it's saved in one tap and you stay where you were.
- Fixed: choosing Watch later from a video's long-press menu could start the video instead.

**Look and feel**
- New default look: the vivid Lime accent and the Glib gradient app icon (if you never changed the icon, it switches on update; your accent colour stays as you set it, so pick Lime in Settings → Appearance if you'd like it).
- The dock and mini player sit a little higher, in easier reach.
- Audio player: the current chapter is centred just above the progress bar.
- Fixed: swiping the audio player down dragged a see-through panel along with the artwork.

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/capheproject/BetterTube#changelog).
